target: D=Y_terminal(repair_once)-Y_terminal(no_repair), including harms; one paired realization per record/regime.

features.definition: T64 is the minimum intended-task-aligned response of the two output ports after64 normalized signed graph-transfer iterations with the input port clamped at1. R(w) is the already specified packet-only graph completion. Task rule and port geometry are shared externally supplied apparatus.
features.counterfactual_cost: Candidate must compute a dry-run repair for every evaluated packet, even if a policy later declines to apply it; charge solver CPU and both transfer calculations. No new full native read.

fit.method: Weighted ridge regression on paired difference; weighted training-fold centering/scaling; intercept unpenalized.
fit.justification: One fixed strong shrinkage level, three standardized features and an intercept for only16 independent blocks and13 discordant record/regimes. No tuning search; candidate failure ends this version.

comparators.regime_mean: Training-fold weighted mean observed benefit separately in each noise regime.

costs.shared: Current boundary and existing forecasting apparatus/transfer calculations are not free. Reused probe costs stay in the report; no measured full-cost policy superiority follows from squared-error ranking.

validation.split: Leave one whole acquisition block out; keep all related founders, histories, recipients and both noise regimes together. Training-fold standardization only.
validation.weighting: Each acquisition block equal, within block current-fail and current-pass classes each half, noise regimes each half. Regression training weights normalized within the training fold.
validation.interpretation: Family and plan chosen after inspecting earlier outcomes. Whole-block exclusion prevents training leakage for this fixed recipe; the resulting scores remain exposed-data development diagnostics, not untouched validation.
validation.metrics: Paired-difference mean squared prediction error separately in both noise regimes; all block losses, all comparator gains and all out-of-block predictions retained. No bin/stratum rescue or confidence-based confirmation from overlapping folds.

gate.rule: Proceed to measuring feasibility of a new-founder test only if the candidate has strictly lower out-of-block paired-difference MSE than every declared comparator in each noise regime. Equality fails. No claim of significance or useful effect size from passing this screen.
gate.if_fail: Preserve candidate, coefficients and all results. Do not tune this version or launch fresh scientific futures merely to rescue it.
gate.if_pass: Freeze final all-development-data coefficients before new founder acquisition; separately specify and qualify endpoint/comparators/resource contract and benchmark runtime. No automatic launch from this script.

policy_diagnostics.always_repair: Show the observed weighted repair-once-all effect and full applied-repair count as a baseline.
policy_diagnostics.candidate_positive: Apply only when out-of-block predicted benefit is strictly positive; threshold0 fixed as the sign of expected terminal benefit, without a selected penalty. Compute offline expected outcome from the existing two branches.
policy_diagnostics.comparators: Same sign rule for all benefit models; include no-repair. Report applied repairs, physical dry-run solver requirements, probe costs and value. Different resource vectors are not a matched-budget policy competition or sequential scheduler validation.
policy_diagnostics.risk_rank: No new outcome-selected risk threshold or top-k policy is constructed.

rdt_scope: A conventional action-aware regression is a possible useful reduction. No RDT-specific law or autonomous repair follows from a positive screen.
